_comment: Performance budgets enforced by scripts/perf/benchmarks/compare.mjs check. maxJsKb is the approximate client JS payload per route (summed from client-reference-manifest chunks, see lib/core.mjs); values are uncompressed bytes and include shared framework chunks. Calibrated against the current Turbopack build — revisit after major dependency or routing changes. Runtime values align with lighthouserc.json assertions.
